units.source_text: 古歌：“祓禊洗手川，誓不谈恋情。

en.t: An old poem says: At the Mitarashi River of purification, I swear never to speak of love.

units.source_text: 神明闻此誓，掩耳不要听。”

en.t: When the gods hear this vow, they cover their ears and refuse to listen.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 洗手川是寺院门前的川。

en.t: The Mitarashi River is the river in front of a temple gate.

units.source_text: 引用此句，意谓浮舟将断绝恋情而投水。

en.t: By quoting these lines, the meaning is that Ukifune will break off her love and throw herself into the water.
